errors.text: The hypothesis treats the SRO free-energy contribution as negligible near melting, whereas the target finds a non-negligible solid stabilization of about 2.4 meV/atom and an approximately 25 K melting-point shift.
The proposed 500- to 1000-atom cells do not reconstruct the required 12x12x12, 3456-atom supercell boundary for validating SRO over 2000-2400 K.

It implies that the MTP itself captures electronic entropy and Fermi-level DOS effects; these electronic Gibbs-energy contributions require explicit finite-temperature electronic DFT treatment and are not automatically represented by a conventional configuration-based MTP.
